usage: Étude artistique, sans intégration Godot ni validation de Raphaël.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: illustrated art-direction proposal for the full-screen CHARACTER SELECT submenu of the existing pixel-art videogame VESTIGES. One 16:9 landscape screen, about 1920x1080. NOT a redesign of its launch screen.
Input images: image 1 is the existing Vagabond portrait: preserve his distinctive compact silhouette, brown coat, orange scarf, brimmed hat, oversized travel backpack with rolls, weary human face. Image 2 is the existing launch background: use ONLY as a palette, world and deliberate chunky pixel-art reference. Do NOT reproduce its layout or bonfire and do not redesign that main menu.
Primary request: a convincing authored videogame menu with a strong pixel-art identity and exceptional composition. The world is a familiar abandoned French town being forgotten; it crumbles into pale absence. Design language: worn town masonry, broken plaster, erased traces, warm amber highlights. Stone is ordinary urban limestone with render and exposed chips, never fantasy temple masonry. Quiet, melancholic, tangible, compelling. Build the screen as an illustrated scene with integrated controls, not a collection of UI boxes.
Composition:
Top restrained navigation inscribed along a thin broken architectural lintel, exact French: "PERSONNAGES" (active, brighter ivory), "QUÊTES", "COLLECTION". Small shoulder-button glyphs at its ends. No full website header, logo, hero marketing text or giant full-width tab rectangles.
Left narrow roster about 18% width: four compact pixel portrait medallions with short adjacent names, vertically spaced on one continuous worn dark masonry edge, no individual rectangular cards. "Le Vagabond" selected with a tiny amber pointer and a small permanent check; "Le Traqueur", "La Forgeuse", "Le Facteur". Draw them understated, Vagabond clear.
Center-left, about 43% width: the Vagabond very large and visually dominant, three-quarter full-body scene, no enclosing square portrait card. A stone street fragment under his boots. Low ruined wall and a few ivy leaves behind him. His scene merges into the screen through an irregular border of sparse disappearing off-white pixels on one side. Do not make his face disappear. Far background muted indigo void and barely visible town silhouettes; major quiet dark negative space.
Right about 35% width: one calm reading surface of charcoal plaster on a broken wall fragment. It has hand-drawn irregular contour, shallow depth, upper-left lit stone facets, dark underside, exposed chips only at corners. Not multiple repeated boxes. Heading "LE VAGABOND" in bold tall condensed utilitarian lettering, readable ivory. Underneath "Équilibré, mobile, endurant." Three well-spaced groupings, separated by short worn incised horizontal marks and generous blank space: "INSTINCT NOMADE" / "+8 % vitesse · +0,2 régénération"; "ARME DE DÉPART" with a beautiful enlarged pixel-art garden sickle icon and text "Faucille" / "Fauche en arc devant toi."; "MOBILITÉ" / "Dash". A compact final line "PV 100    Vitesse 200". Correct exact French spelling, no additional invented copy or lore revelation. No giant floating stat dashboard.
Bottom integrated foot of the composition, deep charcoal and worn townstone: left small "B  Retour"; near center-right "A  Choisir"; farther right the one primary "PARTIR" action on an amber-lit chipped stone tab, solid hand-drawn pixel relief, substantial but not a web CTA pill. Above it tiny readable "Personnage choisi". Sparse foot controls with clear spacing, no settings or quit here, those belong to the main menu.
Style/medium: true carefully drawn pixel-art illustration. Visible intentional clusters and stepped contours at a consistent grid comparable to 480x270 art enlarged nearest-neighbor. Rich designed shapes with 4-6 tonal planes per material, selected dithering only in transitions to absence. No oil-paint stipple, no uniformly applied noise texture or photo texture. Clear readable UI text can have a finer resolution than artwork. Edges, selection pointer, sickle and roster are bespoke drawn sprites. Sophisticated volume from overlap, hard cast shadows, broken contour and upper-left highlights. Keep texture subdued behind the text.
Palette: charcoal #1A1A2E, warm dark gray #3A3535, worn gray #6B6161, pale gray #9E9494, ivory #E8E0D4, erasure #F5F0EB, selective gold #D4A843 and orange #E07B39, muted purple #4A3066. Warmth centered on the character and selected action, erasure at far edges. Essential text and controls never dissolve.
Avoid: website layout, CSS mockup, dashboard, rounded cards, thin generic rectangular outlines everywhere, frosted glass, blur panels, neon sci-fi borders, fake medieval ornament, runes, religious sculpture, gold filigree, maximalist stone blocks around every label, particle confetti, a new main menu, narrative spoilers, names of the forgotten people, explanatory slogans, arbitrary locked silhouettes. This is one finished-looking art study, not a contact sheet, not a photo of a screen, no annotations or watermark.
